projects.name: Candlestick Point
projects.homes_note: plan of ~7,200 homes plus 2.8M sq ft office (Pipeline row still shows 9,637 for the old combined Candlestick / Shipyard II plan)
projects.status: Developer FivePoint broke ground on site infrastructure (roads, sidewalks, utilities) in Sept 2026. First building, ~40% affordable, follows the infrastructure.
projects.gap: Entitled ('PL Approved'); no housing building permit issued or filed.

projects.name: Potrero Power Station
projects.status: Phased build-out under way: first affordable building (105 homes) opened; excavation reported under way on Block 2 in Feb 2026.
projects.gap: Individual buildings count once permitted; the unpermitted remainder of the master plan does not.

projects.name: Treasure Island / Yerba Buena Island
projects.status: Phase I infrastructure and two housing developments (229 homes) complete; a 100-home senior building was expected to start in Sept 2026.
projects.gap: Long phased build-out; the remaining phases have no issued building permits.

projects.name: Balboa Reservoir
projects.homes_note: Blocks A (159) and E (128) are already counted as under construction (11 Frida Kahlo Wy)
projects.status: Phase 1A infrastructure began Nov 2025. Permits reported filed for 704 more homes in Sept 2026.
projects.gap: Only the permitted blocks count; later phases are entitled but unpermitted.

projects.name: HOPE SF: Potrero and Sunnydale
projects.homes_note: Potrero 1,400-1,700 and Sunnydale ~1,700 at full build-out; rough sum
projects.status: City-funded infrastructure and phase-by-phase rebuilds of public-housing sites are under way; some buildings (e.g. on Sunnydale Ave) already count.
projects.gap: Later phases are entitled but unpermitted; early phases demolish before replacements finish, which also depresses completions.
